title: Lesson 91 · Three men in a basket

examples.zh: 飞行员注意到一个气球。

examples.en: Three men were standing in a basket.
The pilot managed to circle the balloon.
examples.zh: 飞行员设法绕着气球飞行。

examples.en: The balloon was making for a Royal Air Force Station.
examples.zh: 气球正飞向皇家空军基地。

examples.en: He works at a Royal Air Force Station.
examples.zh: 他在一个皇家空军基地工作。

examples.en: No one was able to explain the mystery.
The officer was in the control tower.
Balloons can be a great danger to aircraft.
examples.zh: 气球对飞机会造成极大的危险。

examples.en: Someone might be spying on the station.
examples.zh: 可能有人在侦察这个基地。

examples.en: The pilot kept track of the strange object.
examples.zh: 飞行员一直跟踪着那个奇怪的物体。

examples.en: The pilot circled the balloon for some time.
examples.zh: 飞行员绕着气球飞了一会儿。

examples.en: One of the men was holding a pair of binoculars.
examples.zh: 其中一个人正拿着一副望远镜。

examples.en: One of the men was taking photographs.
The balloon landed near an airfield.
examples.zh: 气球在一个机场附近着陆了。

sentences.en: A pilot noticed a balloon which seemed to be making for a Royal Air Force Station nearby.
sentences.zh: 一名飞行员注意到一个气球，它似乎正飞往附近的皇家空军基地。

sentences.en: The officer in the control tower was very angry when he heard the news.
sentences.zh: 指挥塔里的军官听到这个消息非常生气，因为气球对飞机会造成极大的危险。

sentences.en: Soon afterwards, the balloon began to descend and it landed near an airfield.
sentences.zh: 不久，气球开始下降，并在一个机场附近着陆了。

sentences.en: The police have been called in, but they have not yet made any arrests.
sentences.zh: 警察被叫来了，但他们尚未逮捕任何人。

sentences.en: The mystery of the three men in the basket is still unsolved.
sentences.zh: 吊篮里三个人的谜仍然没有解开。

article.en: A pilot noticed a balloon which seemed to be making for a Royal Air Force Station nearby.
article.zh: 一名飞行员注意到一个气球，它似乎正飞往附近的皇家空军基地。

article.en: He informed the station at once, but no one there was able to explain the mystery.
article.zh: 他立即报告了基地，但那里没有人能解开这个谜。

article.en: The officer in the control tower was very angry when he heard the news.
article.zh: 指挥塔里的军官听到这个消息非常生气，因为气球对飞机会造成极大的危险。

article.en: He said that someone might be spying on the station and the pilot was ordered to keep track of the strange object.
article.zh: 他说可能有人在侦察这个基地，于是命令飞行员跟踪这个奇怪的物体。

article.en: The pilot managed to circle the balloon for some time.
article.zh: 飞行员设法绕着气球飞了一段时间。

article.en: He could make out three men in a basket under it, and one of them was holding a pair of binoculars.
article.zh: 他能辨认出气球下面吊篮里有三个人，其中一人正拿着一副望远镜。

article.en: When the balloon was over the station, the pilot saw one of the men taking photographs.
article.zh: 当气球飞到基地上空时，飞行员看见其中一人在拍照。

article.en: Soon afterwards, the balloon began to descend and it landed near an airfield.
article.zh: 不久，气球开始下降，并在一个机场附近着陆了。

article.en: The police have been called in, but they have not yet made any arrests.
article.zh: 警察被叫来了，但他们尚未逮捕任何人。

article.en: The mystery of the three men in the basket is still unsolved.
article.zh: 吊篮里三个人的谜仍然没有解开。
